name: Tubi (plugin.video.tubitv)
_comment: PARTIAL BY DESIGN. Every Tubi content endpoint authenticates with a bearer,
and minting the anonymous device token needs a TUBI-HMAC-SHA256 request
signature (see resources/lib/tubi_auth.py) that this declarative engine
cannot compute. So this spec does two things:
1. anonymous_signing_key -- a REAL check of the auth handshake entry
point (the single point of failure: no signing key => no token =>
the whole addon is dead). Analogous to Apple's developerToken check.
2. *_reachable -- report-only probes that confirm each content host still
exists and still answers (401/403 = up and auth-gated, as expected).
They cannot verify response SHAPE without a real token.
For full shape-checks, Tubi needs either a bespoke checker script (like
Apple TV used to have) or an engine extended with the Tubi signer.

headers.User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:158.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/158.0

checks.note: The auth handshake's first step. Sign-in and every content call depend on it; a rename or shape change here breaks the whole addon. The challenge is a throwaway (the verifier is never submitted), so a signing key comes back without completing PKCE.
Category list host. Needs a bearer; 401/403 unauthenticated is expected. Anything else (404/5xx/connection error) means the host or path moved.
Search host. Bearer required; 401/403 expected unauthenticated.
Title + playables host (a single title and its video_resources). Bearer required; 401/403 expected.
Series seasons/episodes host. Bearer required; 401/403 expected.
Live channel line-up host. May answer 200 anonymously (live needs no account) or 401/403; either proves the host is up.
